scope.purpose: independent purity/safety audit of reciprocal per-view tracklet bridges

deviations.deviation: The critical interval was evaluated across cutoff configurations before frozen_thresholds.json existed.
containment: The critical interval is permanently unblinded descriptive stress evidence and cannot support confirmatory claims.
No critical result may enter hyperparameter selection, tie-breaking, body-length estimation, or clean-motion estimation.
All selection remains training-only; validation remains report-only.
The held-out cohort remains untouched and is the confirmatory cohort after freeze.

deviations.deviation: The A4 retained-tracklet count-mismatch abstention rule was developed after inspection of the unblinded critical safety audit.
containment: Critical-event abstention under this rule is designed safety behavior, not independent evidence of biological identity recovery.
The critical interval remains descriptive only and cannot select or validate the rule.
Held-out performance is the only post-freeze generalization evidence for this safeguard.
deviations.selection_impact: critical evidence excluded; training-only selection and untouched held-out confirmation required

deviations.deviation: The A5 exact-candidate hint safeguards and high-confidence eligibility thresholds were shaped after inspection of the unblinded critical safety audit.
containment: The critical interval is permanently descriptive only and cannot select, tune, validate, or break ties among A5 hint thresholds.
A5 hint thresholds and the frozen A2/A3/A4 dependencies are selected and frozen from authorized training events and length-matched training controls only.
Validation remains report-only and cannot alter the frozen configuration.
The untouched held-out cohort is the only post-freeze generalization evidence for the A5 safeguard.
deviations.selection_impact: critical evidence excluded; training-only threshold freeze required before validation, with held-out as the sole post-freeze generalization test
